mapper.sql: id, user_id, product_id, product_name, points_cost, status, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exchange_record (user_id, product_id, product_name, points_cost, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{pointsCost}, 1)
